findings.summary: isFullSuite tests SUITE_INVOCATION against the raw, untrimmed command, so a full-suite invocation with any leading whitespace is misread as not a full suite.

A redirect token whose target is already embedded via the `(?:&\d+)?` group (e.g. `2>&1`, `N>&M`) still produces an empty `redirect[1]` capture, so the scanner wrongly treats it like a bare `>` and skips the following token as if it were a separate redirect target.
isFullSuite tests SUITE_INVOCATION against the raw, untrimmed command, so a full-suite invocation with leading whitespace is misread as not a full suite.

A redirect token that is a self-contained file-descriptor duplication (e.g. `2>&1`) still produces an empty `redirect[1]` capture, so the scanner treats it like a bare `>` and wrongly skips the following token as if it were a separate redirect target.

theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.whatScoreSays: FIRED, both draws. By the control's rule a blocking finding on a clean subject is a precision failure, and FIRED is red.
theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.whatTheFindingsAreAbout: Neither finding is about the arm under measurement. The clean arm's changes are at new-side lines 7-11, 22, 25, 28, 30, 38 and 41 — the renamed locals and the extracted looksLikePath predicate. theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.andBothFindingsAreTRUE: Measured by running the subjects rather than by reading them. isFullSuite('  bun test') returns false in BOTH baseline.ts and clean.ts, and isFullSuite('bun test 2>&1 test/foo.test.ts') returns true in both. The reviewer found two real, pre-existing defects in the compacted subject copy. It did not invent them and it did not object to the refactor.
theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.soTheReadingIs: A precision reading of red, whose cause is the reviewer reviewing the whole FILE rather than the DIFF. The control cannot tell a precision failure about the arm from a true observation about the subject — which is the sentence the critical@39 confound already earned, arriving again from a different direction.
theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.whatWasNOTDone: The subject was not repaired, and must not be. It is supposed to carry its plant, and #1524 bars repairing it when a reviewer flags it. A finding against a control subject is a reading, not a bug report. Equally, AI_REVIEW_SEVERITIES was not changed and nothing was added to REVIEW.md's Do not flag list — shaping the instrument to produce a nicer reading is the one move that would make the whole measurement worthless.
theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.itWasPREDICTEDBeforeItWasDrawn: README.md warned, in a section written before this reading and merged as 3cfceb05, that this subject carries a second confound 'one severity band from breaking the clean arm': isFullSuite returns false on any command it cannot parse and its own docblock calls false the permissive answer, so a reviewer can truthfully flag it as fail-open; priced medium it costs an advisory slot, priced high or critical it makes suite-lock-redirect/clean score FIRED on a finding that has nothing to do with the plant. Both draws priced it HIGH and both scored FIRED. The line-19 finding's own failure_scenario quotes the same docblock sentence the prediction quotes. The prediction named a mechanism and a severity threshold before the draw, and the draw matched both.
theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.theConfoundThisIsNOT: This is not the critical@39 confound #1513 removed. That one came from staging a compacted copy at a path whose live callers import the real module, and it is absent from every payload here — no finding in any of the four measured draws objects that the module no longer exports what its callers import. This one comes from the compacted copy carrying latent defects of its own on lines the diff does not touch.
theCleanArmFIREDAndTheCAUSEIsNotTheARM.whatWouldSeparateThem: A clean candidate whose baseline the reviewer has nothing true to say about, or a reading that scopes the finding set to changed lines before scoring. Neither exists today; both are changes to the instrument and are out of scope for a measurement issue. Filed as a gap rather than fixed here.

thirdReadings.theCriticalAt39ConfoundIsAbsent: No payload in any of the four measured draws contains a finding of the critical@39 shape. That is consistent with the eight readings after #1513 and is a second subject's worth of evidence for it.

whatThisIsNOTGroundsFor.doNotTickCRCA4: Two draws is not a variance estimate, and these two draws per arm are attempts of a SINGLE workflow run on a byte-identical tree — the same weakness #1513 recorded, not a new independent sample. The reviewer is a sampled instrument (#1290, CRC-B3). .claude/rules/claiming-sc-coverage.md is explicit. Nothing is ticked on the back of this.
whatThisIsNOTGroundsFor.andTheCleanArmIsRED: Even read generously, half of this subject's reading is a failing outcome. A control with one green arm and one red arm is not evidence that the gate discriminates; it is evidence of exactly what it says — DETECTED twice on the plant, FIRED twice on the clean variant.
whatThisIsNOTGroundsFor.theRecallSideIsStillOnlyTwoPoints: DETECTED twice at a fresh round 1 says the reviewer located this silent logic defect, at the declared line, in both draws it produced a payload for. It is not a bound on how often it would.
